spectrumRules: The spectrum is a functional design grammar, not a scientific emotion hierarchy.
Routes may visit a subset of bands and do not need to follow a rigid rainbow ladder.
Essential meaning never depends on color alone.
Frequency may refer only to actual audio, tempo, recurrence, event density or clearly labeled mythopoetic language.
No consciousness score, emotional frequency number or fabricated telemetry is permitted.
Return synthesizes the route spectrum from committed decisions and traced relations.

eligibleConditions: meaningful decisions committed in at least two semantic families
a relation traced across at least two worlds
a repeated pulse glyph explicitly discovered and activated

nodes.function: Represent unintegrated potential, fragmented information and incomplete relations without moral judgment.

nodes.title: THRESHOLD
nodes.function: Consent, accessibility, orientation, intention and first meaningful decision.

nodes.title: PROLOGUE
nodes.function: Establish the question, context and reading grammar through verified author material and portfolio artifacts.

nodes.title: DESCENT
nodes.function: Reduce noise and reveal uncertainty, contradiction, absence or hidden structure.

nodes.title: ARCHIVE

nodes.title: MACHINE
nodes.function: Reveal computational transformation, simulation, generative rules and inspectable code.

nodes.title: HEART / 0
nodes.function: Offer an optional sanctuary that restores orientation and connects worlds through a non-scoring pulse.

nodes.title: COSMOLOGY
nodes.function: Connect the local path to larger systems across time, territory, culture, ecology, technology and possible futures.

nodes.title: RETURN / +∞
nodes.function: Converge through memory, provenance, relation, reflection, contribution and re-entry without requiring Heart.

nodes.title: THE COMMONS / PUBLIC TRACE WALL
nodes.function: Offer an optional moderated public surface where visitors may write, draw, observe accumulated traces, report content, exit or re-enter KODEX.

invariants: Every decision changes a later consequence.
Every canonical route preserves privacy-minimized session memory.
Every route provides an immediate safe exit.
Every completed route converges semantically rather than redirecting mechanically.
Heart is optional and never a rank, score or mandatory checkpoint.
Entering Heart is voluntary and leaving it restores the exact prior route anchor.
Core journey nodes use one active 100svh scene without document scroll.
The Commons Wall is an optional postscript and the only planned canonical document-scroll exception.
Public contributions require preview, consent, moderation, reporting and withdrawal behavior.
No deployment occurs without APROBAR DEPLOY.
